input.summary: Change § 15.3(b) cap basis to 12 months' fees and carve out indemnification, confidentiality, gross negligence and willful misconduct.
input.comment: [Playbook] Our position is a mutual cap based on the fees paid or payable in the twelve months preceding the claim, with indemnification, confidentiality, gross negligence and willful misconduct sitting outside the cap; a 3% bill-of-materials cap with no carve-outs would put MSL's indemnities under Section 15.1 inside an illusory cap. We have kept the mutual structure of the existing sentence and changed only the basis and the carve-outs.

ops.oldText: is limited to three percent (3%) of the value of the bill of materials contained in the Products delivered to IBM and IBM Customers by MSL in the period beginning with the Effective Date of the Agreement through the resolution of the action.
ops.newText: is limited to the fees paid or payable by IBM to MSL under this Agreement in the twelve (12) months preceding the claim; provided that this limitation does not apply to either Party's indemnification obligations, breach of its confidentiality obligations, gross negligence, or willful misconduct.
